استحمرن (form X)
# اِسْتَحْمَرْنَ (istaḥmarna) /is.taħ.mar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اُسْتُحْمِرْنَ (ustuḥmirna) /us.tuħ.mir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
# اِسْتَحْمِرْنَ (istaḥmirna) /is.taħ.mir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْمَرَ (istaḥmara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
